compliance.summary: The shared banners promote an unapproved benchmark offer and AI transformation positioning rather than GoGloby’s staffing and recruiting services. The forms also make an unverified response-time promise.

problems.title: Benchmark CTA is unapproved
problems.issue: The banner promotes a benchmark and technical briefing, which are not the approved service-specific calls to action.
problems.fix: Replace the benchmark pitch and briefing CTA with wording for the relevant recruiting or staffing service.

problems.title: AI transformation positioning
problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity
problems.issue: The banner presents AI transformation as GoGloby’s offer rather than its staffing and recruiting services.
problems.fix: Replace the transformation positioning with positioning consistent with the approved company description and services.

problems.title: Unverified response-time promise

problems.fix: Remove the response-time promise or verify it with the company before retaining it.

site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and generative AI development provider, including offers the company no longer sells. It also contains unsupported service promises and claims that conflict with the current service definitions.

problems.title: Outdated company positioning
problems.issue: The schema describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner and a talent acquisition agency rather than using the approved company description.
problems.fix: Replace the outdated company descriptions with the approved one-sentence description.

problems.page_value: Applied AI Engineering Partner; talent acquisition agency
problems.source_value: GoGloby is a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.

problems.title: Unverified delivery promises
problems.issue: The schema promises profile delivery in 72 hours, a validated feature in 3 to 5 business days, a five-day recruiting shortlist, and hiring 50 percent faster than US job boards; these claims are not in the Fact Sheet.
problems.fix: Remove the unsupported delivery and speed promises.

problems.title: Staffing guarantee differs
problems.issue: The schema claims a 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee, while the staffing terms specify no-cost replacement if performance falls below baseline and cancellation at any time in the first 120 days.
problems.fix: Replace the staffing guarantee claim with the current performance-based replacement and cancellation terms.
problems.subject: Staffing guarantee
problems.source_value: No-cost replacement if results fall below baseline; cancel any time in the first 120 days

locations.quote: 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee.

problems.title: Insurance coverage overclaimed
problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Legal and security
problems.issue: The schema describes a $3M combined policy that includes professional liability, while the Fact Sheet specifies $3M data and cyber-liability insurance.
problems.fix: Change the insurance description to match the Fact Sheet and remove the unsupported professional-liability claim.
problems.subject: Insurance coverage

locations.quote: $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) from day one.
$3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) included.

problems.title: Unsupported IP guarantee
problems.issue: “Zero IP exposure” is an unsupported absolute claim; the Fact Sheet says clients own the IP and engineers work inside the client's environment.
problems.fix: Remove the unsupported absolute claim and use only the documented IP and security terms.
problems.subject: IP protection claim
problems.source_value: Client owns all IP; engineers work inside the client's secure development environment

locations.quote: Zero IP exposure.
